meaning: High-score ladder depth: HSCORL reserves 3 BCD score bytes x 5 rungs (.BLKB 3*5); BEST is read from HSCORL+<3*4> (index 4, the fifth rung). MC threads depth 5 through @shared/highscore rather than the shared default of 10.
Seeded default ladder rung 1 (BEST), initials DFT: SCOINI little-endian BCD triple [00,75,00] = 7500.
Seeded default ladder rung 2, initials DLS: SCOINI little-endian BCD triple [95,74,00] = 7495.
Seeded default ladder rung 3, initials SRC: SCOINI little-endian BCD triple [30,73,00] = 7330.
Seeded default ladder rung 4, initials RDA: SCOINI little-endian BCD triple [05,70,00] = 7005.
Seeded default ladder rung 5 (lowest), initials MJP: SCOINI little-endian BCD triple [50,69,00] = 6950.

Default ladder initials MJPRDASRCDLSDFT — 5 x 3 chars copied into INITAL positionally with SCOINI: MJP RDA SRC DLS DFT (ascending storage; DFT pairs with the BEST rung). The programmers' initials easter egg.

The insert-on-qualify ladder update MC's qualifiesForHighScore/insertHighScore realize: search the 5-deep ladder for the new score's rung and insert, dropping the lowest. UPDATE HIGH SCORE LADDER -> SEARCH -> INSERT.
